title: bf16+ZeRO1+CPU offload silently routes through bf16 wrapper; extra-large param uses raw param.grad instead of reduction grad
root_cause: Two related bugs: (a) The dtype dispatch picked the BFLOAT16 optimizer path for bf16+fp32-grad-accum even when CPU offload was on, where it doesn't work correctly. (b) For an extra-large param the reduction code took `self.extra_large_param_to_reduce.grad` directly instead of routing through get_gradient_for_reduction(), so when use_grad_accum_for_reduction was on the accumulated fp32 grad was bypassed and the raw bf16 grad was reduced (loss of precision and stale value).
invariant: When use_grad_accum_for_reduction is True, the tensor passed to average_tensor must be the same object/dtype as get_gradient_for_reduction(param), not param.grad.
diff_summary: Add `and not self.zero_cpu_offload()` to the BFLOAT16 path selection, route extra-large param reduction through get_gradient_for_reduction, and copy from grad_reduc instead of param.grad in the contiguous bucket path.
